description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.event class, providing event handling capabilities such as registering, firing, and removing event listeners, and implementing event features on objects within the CKEditor framework.

classes.name: eventEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual event with its name and list of listeners.

methods.name: implementOn
methods.description: Implements event handling features on a target object.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Fires an event, calling all registered listeners with event data.

methods.name: fireOnce
methods.description: Fires an event and then removes all listeners for that event.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a listener function for a specific event.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a listener function from an event.

methods.name: hasListeners
methods.description: Checks if there are any listeners registered for a specific event.
